name: second derivative
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中附加钢轨变形空间函数的二阶变化率。
usage_overview: 在路基长距离沉降分析中，用于刻画附加钢轨变形沿线路方向的空间弯曲特征，并作为车辆加速度拟合的关联变量，联系附加不平顺形态与车辆振动响应。

complete_examples.text: Based on the correlation between the vehicle responses and the second derivative of additional deformation of rails, the threshold of long-distance settlement can be determined.
The second derivative of the additional deformation of the rail induced by subgrade settlement has a strong coherence with the car body acceleration in the low-frequency domain.

P083.title: Study on the long-distance settlement threshold of high-speed railway subgrade based on vehicle responses
P083.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, J Xu
P083.label: Li等（2024）

contexts.text: 表征附加不平顺沿空间的曲率变化，是车辆加速度拟合的关联变量。
contexts.title: 基于车辆响应的高速铁路路基长距离沉降阈值研究
